statement: A company comes into existence through the commercial register: it is entered in the register and its passive legal capacity commences as of the entry (Commercial Code § 2(2), (3)). The management board petitions for entry of a private limited company (osaühing); the petition is notarially certified or digitally signed, digitally signed petitions go through the electronic commercial register (the e-Business Register), and under the expedited procedure the registrar reviews the petition no later than the next working day after receipt (Commercial Register Act §§ 40, 42).
caveat: The founders first conclude a memorandum of association with the articles of association annexed (Commercial Code § 138); foundation through a notary stays available where the founders cannot sign digitally. Under the expedited procedure a petition received after the end of a working day counts as submitted the following working day (Commercial Register Act § 42(2)).
